name: Threshold share — the leading claim must clear a bar
purpose: Show a policy that resolves only when the leading claim's share of counted publishers reaches the set basis points.
expected_outcome: RESOLVED when the leading claim reaches the share; UNRESOLVED_CONFLICT when it falls short even with a plurality.

create_flow_inputs.step_1_question: Is the official GenLayer token contract address published for StudioNet?
create_flow_inputs.step_8_review_expect: threshold rendered as 75% of counted publishers; minimum three independent publishers

manual_checks_after_observe: The summary states how many of the counted groups back the state.
Lower the threshold to 6001 (60.01%) in a variant run to see the same evidence resolve differently.
Raise it to 9000 (90%): identical evidence goes UNRESOLVED_CONFLICT — the bar does the deciding, in code.
